criteria.name: Accurate to policy
criteria.pass: Everything the reply states or promises (rules, time frames, prices, discounts, warranty, what happens next) matches the reference policy and the facts in the customer's message. Judge only what the reply says: something left out is judged by 'Answers the question', and whether the case should go to a specialist is judged by 'Escalates when required'. So a reply that deals with a case itself when it should have gone to a specialist doesn't fail here for that reason.

criteria.name: Answers the question
criteria.pass: The reply directly addresses everything the customer asked, or, when it can't answer yet, says clearly what will happen next and when. Judge only whether each question is addressed: whether the answer is correct is judged by 'Accurate to policy', and whether the case should go to a specialist by 'Escalates when required'.

criteria.name: Escalates when required
criteria.pass: When the message matches one of the policy's escalation triggers, the reply hands the case to a specialist, says they will reply within 1 business day, and gives immediate safety advice where relevant. When no trigger applies, the reply handles the request itself.

criteria.name: Appropriate tone
criteria.pass: Polite, plain and respectful. No blame, sarcasm, condescension or shouting.

vagueCriteria.name: Handles the situation
vagueCriteria.pass: The reply handles the situation appropriately.

caught.quote: I can guarantee that your order will be delivered tomorrow.
caught.reason: The policy says agents must never guarantee a delivery date, yet the reply guarantees delivery tomorrow.
caught.customer: I placed order SSG-48271 with standard shipping three business days ago, but it hasn't arrived yet. When will it come?
caught.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for checking in about order SSG-48271. Standard shipping usually takes 3–7 business days, so your order is still within that estimated window. I can guarantee that your order will be delivered tomorrow.

If you've received a shipping confirmation email, you can use the tracking link in it to check for updates. Please let us know if you need help finding the link.

Best,
Maya
